description: Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr) is an open data portal listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Korea (data.go.kr). Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr). This harvest searched it with infrastructure and hazard phrases in English and Korean and read 11,711 datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, digital or facility element or a hazard are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (statistics, laws, contracts, culture, health and ... Coverage: South Korea. 11,711 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 6,210 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
